diabetes mellitus significantly increased integrins gene expressions in rat endometrial at the time of implantation.

the expression of all studied Itg subunit increased significantly in diabetic rat's endometria compared with control group, while treatment with pioglitazo significantly reduced the level compared with diabetic rats.

diabetes mellitus significantly increases the expression of Itgs subunits in rat's endometerium at the time of implantation and treatment with metformin could increase the expression of some subunits.

the role of Itg subunit gene expression in the endometrial implantation process in diabetic rat model.
the expression of Itgs subunits in diabetic rats' uterus and their role in the implantation process.
the role of Itg in embryo implantation and the effect of hyperglycemia in endometrial Itg subunits.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Itg subunit expression is significantly altered in diabetic endometrium, therefore, it could be considered as one of the potential factors involved in implantation failure in diabetes mellitus.
the expression of these Itg subunits could be a new biomarker for the diagnosis of diabetes mellitus in women with infertility and implantation problems.
diabetic patients should be carefully followed up during the pregnancy and the treatment should be adjusted according to the patient condition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
pioglitazones could be used in the management of diabetic patients who want to conceive.
the treatment with pioglitazon could be a good choice for diabetic patients who wish to conceive, while metformin could not be recommended.
the expression of integrin subunits is significantly increased in the endometrial cells of rats with diabetes mellitus.
The main takeaway from our work is that
diabetes mellitus could be one of the reasons for implantation failure and the best treatment option is pioglitazones, not metformins.

the treatment of diabetic patients with pioglitazo could be beneficial in improving the rate of successful pregnancy.
